title: Superexponential van der Waerden numbers

result.label: Superexponential van der Waerden numbers
result.statement: Resolves Erdős's superexponential-growth question for van der Waerden numbers. If Wr(k) is the least interval length forcing a monochromatic k -term progression in every r -coloring, then Wr(k) k^ ck 2 r for an absolute c > 0, all r ≥ 2 and sufficiently large k , uniformly in r . In particular, Wr(k)^ 1/k for each fixed r .
